fields.sql: INSERT INTO shift_slot (tenant_id, team_id, name, start_time, end_time, headcount, required_role_tags, min_seniority, display_order) VALUES ('{{ Current User.shiftyTenantId }}'::uuid, :team_id::uuid, :name, :start_time::time, :end_time::time, :headcount::smallint, string_to_array(NULLIF(:required_role_tags, ''), ',')::text[], NULLIF(:min_seniority, '')::smallint, COALESCE(NULLIF(:display_order, '')::smallint, 0)) RETURNING id
